settings.baseStyle: Soft cinematic illustration, warm tungsten lighting, cozy aesthetic, painterly brush strokes, muted earth tones with amber highlights, gentle bokeh, modern indie storybook style
settings.baseNegative: No text, no letters, no captions, no watermark, no logo, no realistic photography, no harsh shadows, no overly busy details
settings.topic: A quiet rainy afternoon in a small neighborhood cafe

scenes.story_en: Rain taps softly on the cafe window. The street outside blurs into amber lights.
scenes.imagePrompt: Interior of a cozy small cafe, viewed from a window seat. Heavy rain streaks down the window glass. Outside: a blurry street with warm amber streetlights and faint silhouettes of passing umbrellas. Inside: a single empty wooden table near the window, a small ceramic vase with a single dried branch, warm tungsten light from a pendant lamp.
scenes.videoPrompt: Rain streams continuously down the window pane, gentle drift of light bokeh outside, the room interior remains still and warm.

scenes.story_en: A barista wipes the counter slowly. Steam curls from a fresh espresso.
scenes.imagePrompt: Behind a wooden cafe counter, a young barista in a navy apron quietly wipes the polished surface with a cream cloth. To the right, a small white espresso cup sits on a saucer with thick steam curling upward. Background: a wall of glass jars with coffee beans, soft warm light catching the shelves.
scenes.videoPrompt: The barista's hand moves slowly across the counter; steam from the espresso cup curls upward in a soft, continuous drift.

scenes.story_en: Three small things on the table. A cup, a notebook, a fountain pen.
scenes.imagePrompt: Three distinct objects on PURE WHITE BACKGROUND (#FFFFFF, completely solid white, no gradient, no texture, no shadow). Arranged horizontally with at least 80 pixels of pure white space between each. Left to right: 1) a small cream ceramic cappuccino cup with light foam art, 2) a leather-bound A5 notebook with a thin red bookmark ribbon, 3) a slim brass fountain pen. Each object centered vertically, equal sizing, no overlap, hand-drawn flat 2D illustration with clean dark outlines.

scenes.story_en: He opens the notebook. The page is empty, waiting.
scenes.imagePrompt: Top-down view of two hands gently opening a leather-bound notebook on a wooden cafe table. The pages are cream, slightly textured, completely empty (no readable letters or marks). A brass fountain pen rests beside the notebook. A small white espresso cup with a saucer on the upper-right corner. Soft amber light from the side, gentle shadow from the page edges.
scenes.videoPrompt: Two hands gently turn the cream notebook page; the brass fountain pen stays still beside it; soft amber light shifts slowly.

scenes.story_en: Outside the window, the rain begins to ease.
scenes.imagePrompt: Through a rain-streaked cafe window: a wet cobblestone street, fading rain, soft amber streetlights creating warm reflections on the wet ground. A few people walking with umbrellas closing. Pale grey-blue sky with a hint of clearing. Cozy interior reflection partially visible — a corner of a chair, warm amber light, suggestion of a coffee cup.
